new_code_findings.title: Dangerous execution sink
new_code_findings.recommendation: eval() executes `reply`, which we traced to the model's own output at line 86. A prompt injection your input guardrail can't catch (it succeeds inside the model) or a poisoned tool result becomes remote code execution here — after your output evaluator has already scored the text as fine. Parse with ast.literal_eval/json instead, or run it in a sandbox with no network and no filesystem.
new_code_findings.impact: Remote code execution: whoever controls the model's own output controls the code this process runs (L87).

new_code_findings.title: LLM call with no token ceiling
new_code_findings.recommendation: This LLM call sets no max_tokens — a single response can run to the model's max output. Not a vulnerability by itself; pass an explicit max_tokens / max_output_tokens to bound latency and cost.
new_code_findings.impact: Unpredictable latency/cost on a single call. Not a vulnerability by itself.
